meanings: end, finish (a work, a tale, a telling): 'lay the capstone upon'
derivation: a phrase: cadh 'lay (a stone, a course, a tale)' + et 'the' + hosk 'a lintel; a capstone' + um 'upon' (+S), with the thing ended after it (um X; umo 'upon it'). The counterpart of cadh et tolm hosast 'begin: lay the first stone' (O2859): a telling is laid as a course (cadh trenn), begun with its first stone and ended with its capstone. No new root. Made for V.7 I, 'Rhyna began it, and Halvard gave it its end' (Re hadh Rhyna et tolm hosast ulo, eth re hadh Halvard et hosk umo); unit S09

orrowen: Re vysk hos, eth re dhunn ullen
meanings: One (of them) said, and the other finished: Seren's frame for a line of Halyna's split between the pair
derivation: a phrase: re PST(+S) + vysk S·mysk 'say' (m > v) + hos 'one' + eth 'and' + re PST(+S) + dhunn S·tunn 'complete, finish' (t > dh) + ullen 'the other' ('of that one'). The pair's antiphony (orrowen_v2 §3.9 item 5) as a narrative frame, beside hos eth ullen 'by turns' (O2858). The singular verbs are right: each of the pair speaks alone here, as one voice. V.7, three times (I, II, III); unit S09

meanings: in the same breath; at the same instant ('in one breath')
derivation: a phrase: ul 'in' (+N; h unchanged) + hos 'one' + hoss 'breath'. V.7 I, 'he had gone pale on the wall in the same breath'; unit S09

meanings: the time it takes to fill a lamp: a span of the hearth's night ('the time of the filling of a lamp')
derivation: a phrase, a double construct: fedh 'a time, a season' + loskol 'filling' (losk 'fill' + -Ol; l unchanged as the softened possessor) + reller S·greller 'a lamp' (the softened g drops before a consonant, orrowen_v2 §2.5, as in baegyth reller 'lamplight', O0047). V.7 III, ul fedh loskol reller 'in the time it takes to fill a lamp'; unit S09

meanings: tell a lie; lay a lie (in a mind): make one believe what is false ('lay a lie')
derivation: a phrase: cadh 'lay (a stone, a course, a tale)' + nycul 'a lie' (reserve *neukul-): the Shoreland metaphor 'to tell a tale is to lay a course' (cadh trenn) turned to a lie. Its verbal noun after dem (+N) is dem gadhol nycul: V.7 II, Re yal o haralat dem gadhol nycul ul ol brener, 'it was bidden to lay a lie in our mind' ('it was told to make us believe a lie'); unit S09

meanings: on purpose; as it was meant ('as it was thought')
derivation: a phrase: hosen 'as' + re PST(+S) + yal S·be.PST + kaeveret 'thought; meant' (kaever 'think; mean, intend' + -At), in the shape of the hearth's own formula (Cadhom o hosen re yal cadhat lom). Used because 'on purpose' with dask 'purpose' after a mutating preposition falls into traps: dem nask (N·dask = nask 'eat', lexicon_orrowen.md §8 item 2), ul nask, hy rask, lo rask. V.7 III, 'cut there on purpose' (rytet lo ull hosen re yal kaeveret); unit S09

orrowen: Trenn Hosast: Sull Orrol, Hos Clem
meanings: V.7 Part I: Three Roads, One Hour ('the first course: three roads, one hour')
derivation: a phrase: trenn 'a course; a tale laid in one night' + hosast 'first'; sull 'three' + orrol 'a road' (orr + -Ol; a numeral before a singular, orrowen_v2 §3.1) + hos 'one' + clem 'an hour'. Each part of V.7 was laid on its own night ('in three parts, each on the night its carving was known'), so each part is a trenn; unit S09
logogram: TRENN (39) · FORE (328) · TRENN+course (40) + O l · ORL+notch (138)

orrowen: Trenn Pawast: Vodh re ammadar lont
meanings: V.7 Part II: What We Taught Them ('the second course: what we taught to them')
derivation: a phrase: trenn 'a course' + pawast 'second'; vodh 'what' as the headless relative (pilot I.1: Amm sy myskym los vodh ew et Crenn) + re PST(+S) + ammadar 'teach-1PL' (a vowel: unchanged) + lont 'at them' (the one taught takes lo, as the one given to: Hebb et tolm lom). lont, not so, because so after a verb reads 'their'; unit S09

orrowen: Trenn Sullast: Niltenn sa re ryt lernil umo sost
meanings: V.7 Part III: The Plan That Carved Its Own Defeat ('the third course: a plan that cut defeat upon itself')
derivation: a phrase: trenn 'a course' + sullast 'third'; niltenn 'a plan' + sa REL(+S) + re PST(+S) + ryt 'cut, carve' (r unchanged) + lernil 'a defeat' + umo 'upon it' (the relative's resumptive preposition, pilot I.1 G5; ryt um is the oath's own verb and preposition, Rytom um) + sost 'self'. *o lernil* 'its defeat' is avoided: the softening cannot show on l, so o would read as 'it' (orrowen_v2 §3.5); unit S09
